findings.claim: MINAM Geoservidor ZEE La Libertad layer 39 exposes named polygon classes for Chicama tributary-scale units including Quirripano, Santanero, Ochape, Chuquillanqui and Huancay.
findings.reason_withheld: Exact candidate features must be frozen and checked against ANA Cuenca Chicama 13772; no candidate is an event footprint or operational geometry.

findings.claim: Municipal Ordinance 14-2018-MPSCH explicitly lists Rio Chorobal as a microcuenca and Calipuy, Lamball and Caypanda as its principal quebradas.
findings.reason_withheld: The ordinance supplies nomenclature but not a reproducible GIS boundary for the microcuenca or tributary channels.

findings.claim: Decreto de Urgencia 015-2023 tables associate Rio Chorobal intervention sectors with both Cuenca Huamanzaña and Intercuenca 137711.
findings.reason_withheld: The mixed official sector attribution forbids collapsing all Chorobal reaches into one assumed parent polygon before exact routing/outlet adjudication.

findings.claim: SENAMHI 2013 provides basin-scale hydroclimatic/water-balance and rainfall-runoff model context for Cuenca Chicama.
findings.reason_withheld: Basin-scale relations cannot be transferred directly to named ravine activation or converted into IRFEN thresholds.

findings.claim: The 2022 UPAO thesis supplies secondary hydraulic/floodplain modelling context for the Galaxia-Pampa Hermosa reach.
findings.reason_withheld: Modelled floodplain/design values are not observed event footprints, current capacity or operational thresholds.

next_safe_actions: freeze exact MINAM ZEE layer-39 candidate polygons by name with full source attributes and SHA-256
test each Chicama candidate polygon is spatially contained by or topologically consistent with ANA 13772 before map publication
adjudicate Rio Chorobal reach topology against Huamanzaña 137712 and Intercuenca 137711 before defining an outlet or subcatchment
seek reproducible channel geometry for Calipuy, Lamball and Caypanda independently
extract SENAMHI 2013 station/model metadata without transferring basin-scale calibration to local ravines
keep MasterGIS as methodology reference only
